chunks: And it was narrated in another hadith:
About a man who said, “No, by my father.” He said: “He should seek forgiveness from Allah.”

key_terms.اللَّهَ: Allah, from Whom forgiveness is sought
key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man; the person described in the report
key_terms.لَا وَ أَبِي: an oath-like expression meaning “No, by my father”

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he says, “No, by my father”?
ai.summary: This hadith states that if a person utters the expression “No, by my father,” he should seek forgiveness from Allah. It indicates disapproval of this form of speech and directs the speaker toward istighfar.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4296 - It is narrated in another tradition

about a man who said: "No, by my father."
Imam (as) said: "He should seek forgiveness from Allah (swt)."
